residual_wall_time_limit_s.note: the LOCAL residual is a different instrument from the graded one; the cliff is modelled faithfully, the seconds are not transferable

setup_timeout_s.by: timed module load + setup(), plus HOST_COLD_START_S

memory_limit_mb.by: NOTHING -- the `resource` module does not exist on this platform, so subprocess_worker.py's setrlimit call is caught and skipped, and --runner local is advisory by design
memory_limit_mb.provoked_by: experiments/2026-08-24_p2_p0/linux/ -- provoked on Ubuntu 24.04 under the same official stack, since it cannot be provoked on this platform
memory_limit_mb.accounting_instead: peak working set and peak commit, measured below; both are LOWER bounds on the RLIMIT_AS charge, so the headroom they imply is an UPPER bound

worker_death_restart.by: whest run --runner subprocess restarts a dead worker

predict_response_timeout_s.by: runner-side wait of max(predict_timeout_s, wall_time_limit_s + grace); under Phase 2's 120 s wall the 30 s predict_timeout is NOT the binding constraint
